+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GaloisQuotientGlue
+
+/-!
+# Stable opens on affine Galois quotient charts
+
+Let `L/K` be a finite extension, let `X` carry a semilinear `Gal(L/K)`-action,
+and let `U` be a stable affine open of `X`.  The affine quotient chart is
+`Spec (Γ(U)^Gal(L/K))`.  If `V ≤ U` is stable, the invariant norm construction
+of `GaloisQuotientGlue` covers `V` by basic opens `D(N)` for invariant sections
+`N ∈ Γ(U)`.
+
+This file constructs the corresponding open of the quotient chart as the union
+of the basic opens cut out by those same elements in `Γ(U)^Gal(L/K)`.  Its main
+result is the exact saturation identity
+
+`stableAffineQuotientMap ⁻¹(V/Gal(L/K)) = U.ι ⁻¹(V)`.
+
+Thus stable overlaps already determine honest opens on the affine quotient
+charts.  Constructing and gluing the resulting overlap isomorphisms is a
+separate step.
+
+## Main declarations
+
+* `SemilinearAction.affineQuotientMap` is the canonical map
+  `Spec A ⟶ Spec (A^Gal(L/K))`.
+* `SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen` is the quotient-chart open
+  generated by invariant basic opens contained in `V`.
+* `SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap` is the quotient map on a stable
+  affine chart.
+* `SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen` proves the
+  saturation identity above.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace
+
+namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
+
+namespace SemilinearAction
+
+variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
+variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower K L A]
+variable [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A] [IsSemilinear K L A]
+
+/-- The canonical affine quotient map `Spec A ⟶ Spec (A^Gal(L/K))`, induced by
+the inclusion of the invariant subalgebra. -/
+noncomputable def affineQuotientMap :
+    Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) :=
+  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (invariantsSubalgebra K L A).val)
+
+end SemilinearAction
+
+namespace SemilinearGalAction
+
+variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
+variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
+variable (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) {U : X.Opens} (hU : ρ.IsStableOpen U)
+
+/-- The open of the affine quotient chart generated by invariant basic opens
+`D(N) ≤ V`.  Each index supplies the invariant element
+`⟨N, hN⟩ : Γ(U)^Gal(L/K)` cutting out the corresponding quotient-side basic open. -/
+noncomputable def quotientOpenOfStableSubopen (V : X.Opens) :
+    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
+    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
+    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
+    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
+    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
+    (Spec (CommRingCat.of
+      (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, U)))).Opens := by
+  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
+  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
+  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
+  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
+  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
+  exact ⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V,
+    PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
+      (⟨i.1, i.2.1⟩ : SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, U))
+
+/-- The canonical quotient map from a stable affine chart to the spectrum of
+the invariant subalgebra of its section ring. -/
+noncomputable def stableAffineQuotientMap (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) :
+    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
+    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
+    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
+    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
+    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
+    U.toScheme ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of
+      (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, U))) := by
+  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
+  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
+  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
+  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
+  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
+  exact hUa.isoSpec.hom ≫ SemilinearAction.affineQuotientMap K L Γ(X, U)
+
+/-- **A stable subopen is the pullback of an open on the affine quotient chart.**
+
+The quotient-side open is the union of basic opens defined by invariant sections
+whose source-side basic opens lie in `V`.  The invariant-basic-open covering
+theorem identifies their source-side union with `V`; functoriality of basic opens
+under `Spec` then gives the claimed equality. -/
+theorem stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen [FiniteDimensional K L]
+    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
+    (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) :
+    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
+    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
+    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
+    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
+    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
+    (stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa) ⁻¹ᵁ quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V =
+      U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
+  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
+  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
+  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
+  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
+  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
+  rw [stableAffineQuotientMap, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
+    quotientOpenOfStableSubopen, Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup,
+    Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup]
+  simp only [SemilinearAction.affineQuotientMap]
+  rw [hUa.isoSpec_hom]
+  calc
+    (⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V,
+        U.toSpecΓ ⁻¹ᵁ
+          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (i.1 : Γ(X, U)) :
+            (Spec (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, U))).Opens))
+        = ⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V,
+            U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen i.1 := by
+              congr 1
+              funext i
+              exact U.toSpecΓ_preimage_basicOpen i.1
+    _ = U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V, X.basicOpen i.1) :=
+      (Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup U.ι _).symm
+    _ = U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V := by rw [ρ.iSup_invariantBasicOpen_eq hU hUa hVU hV]
+
+end SemilinearGalAction
+
+end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
